name: fleet-board
description: A pane for the other Claude sessions you run: who is working, who went quiet. Brief, ping, task or stop them, and open new sessions from the pane.

launcher.title: Where new sessions open
launcher.description: auto opens a terminal window when it can and a background tmux session otherwise. Or name one: ghostty, wezterm, tmux.

claudeArgs.title: Extra claude arguments
claudeArgs.description: Added to the claude command of every session opened from the pane, split on spaces. Example: --model opus

quietMinutes.title: Quiet warning (minutes)
quietMinutes.description: A working session that has not changed state for this long gets a warning mark.
